verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting assistant documents a separate template for each meeting scenario, each with its own duration and pre-meeting questions, plus customizable location details and survey questions on booking links. Nothing in the evidence describes per-event-type confirmation rules (for example manual approval or confirmation requirements); daily meeting limits are a different control. missing for 10: per-event-type confirmation/approval rules, explicit confirmation that location is set per template, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer multiple event types with their own durations, locations, custom questions, and confirmation rules

citations.quote: Build a template for every scenario. Client calls, board meetings, team all hands, sales demos—create a custom template for each with specific durations, pre-meeting questions, and reminders.
Customize meeting names, location details, and create branded meeting links.
Add survey questions that automatically collect key details before meeting start
